tok 1.0 "Meter operation registration"

pool market "Metering market"
  lane mpon "MPON"
    start begin "Meter operation"
    task report "Report the meter operation to the GO"
    task acquire "Perform the equipment acquisition"
  lane go "GO"
    task examine "Examine the application of the MPON"
    xor accepted "Application accepted?"
    task reject "Reject the application of the MPON"
    end rejected "Application rejected"
    task confirm "Confirm the application of the MPON"
    task informMpooReg "Inform the MPOO about the registration confirmation of the MPON"
    task informMsposReg "Inform the MSPO about the registration confirmation of the MPON"
    or equipSplit "Equipment acquisition and / or changes?"
    or equipJoin
    eventgw wait "Report of the MPON received?"

    catch doneRep "Successful completion reported" message="Successful completion of the entire process"
    # the maximum time limit is not stated in the text; P30D is an assumed value
    catch late "Maximum time limit passed" timer=P30D
    task confirmFail "Confirm the failure of the assignment to the MPON"
    task informMpooFail "Inform the MPOO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON"
    task informMsposFail "Inform the MSPO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON"
    end failed "Failure of the assignment confirmed"
    task assign "Assign the MPON"
    task confirmAssign "Confirm the assignment to the MPON"
    task informMpooOk "Inform the MPOO about the assignment of the MPON"
    task informMsposOk "Inform the MSPO about the assignment of the MPON"
    task informSp "Inform the SP about the assignment of the MPON"
    end done "Assignment completed"
    task informLate "Inform the MPON about the failure of the overall transaction by deadline"
    end lateEnd "Failure by deadline reported"
  lane mpoo "MPOO"
    task changes "Perform the equipment changes"

flow begin -> report -> examine -> accepted
flow accepted -> reject "no"
flow reject -> rejected
flow accepted -> confirm "yes"

flow wait -> doneRep
flow wait -> late
flow failRep -> confirmFail -> informMpooFail -> informMsposFail -> failed
flow doneRep -> assign -> confirmAssign -> informMpooOk -> informMsposOk -> informSp -> done
flow late -> informLate -> lateEnd
